title: Restore CKC linked images, folders, albums, and media notes
operator_request: CKC links images and folders to a character sheet, creates albums per character, and supports image-specific notes and tags.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: MT-010 product patch is ready for validation in ../wtc-ckc-posekit-overhaul. Verify the focused ckc_media test filter and then continue with MT-039 for backend reload/refetch persistence proof before claiming CKC linked-media persistence complete.

scope.summary: Bring CKC media linking back to production parity: character-linked images/folders/albums, media notes, and reusable typed media refs.
base_scope: Map existing Loom/assets/Atelier media refs to CKC character sheet versions.
Implement character albums and folder/image link management.
Separate image notes/tags from character sheet notes.
Make linked media rows inspectable, selectable, and draggable/reusable in other Handshake surfaces.
Update internal UserManual with CKC media and album workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A CKC character can show linked images/folders/albums.
Image notes/tags are distinct from character sheet notes.
Linked media persists through the existing backend authority path.
Argus can inspect and steer album/media rows.
verification: Backend tests for media link persistence.
Native UI tests for album/media rows and stable author_ids.
Argus evidence for media selection and notes surface.

handoff.summary: Patched native Atelier CKC linked-media surface with explicit album target readout, media backend mode, parallel actor field, selected album/media/folder/source/status readouts, no implicit first-album fallback for links, local non-persistence status warnings, Argus-steerable media notes/tags save, and internal manual coverage. Focused ckc_media tests passed. Do not claim full backend persistence complete until MT-039 proves backend roundtrip plus reload/refetch reconstruction.

validation_v1.validated_by: INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR (acting as per-MT WP Validator per Operator directive)
validation_v1.method: Committed-source review (git base 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 14 read-only sub-agents that each read Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL. Adjudicated against independently-verified git ground truth. Fresh runtime re-execution was ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM at validation time (backend later recompiled clean after Operator freed memory).
validation_v1.basis: Linked images/folders/albums/media notes; committed real-PG POST->store->fresh-GET round-trip, per-image notes distinct from sheet notes, honest local-fallback never claims persistence; migration 0339. (Frontend reload property was follow-on MT-039.)
